item.title: MiSide's Cupid's Care Diaper Drive helping families in need this February
item.description: MiSide Community Impact Network is running their Cupid's Care Diaper Drive all month long. The goal is to collect 10,000 diapers for local families.

item.title: Sterling Heights Wendy's employees say they've worked without heat for years
item.description: Employees at a Sterling Heights Wendy's say they've been working without heat for years, forcing them to wear multiple layers and coats while serving customers.

item.title: Washtenaw County sheriff hosts town hall on immigration enforcement
item.description: Community members packed a Washtenaw County town hall Thursday night as Sheriff Alyshia Dyer addressed immigration enforcement and residents' rights.
